agyos_skill.intent: Terraform infrastructure as code workflow for provisioning cloud resources, creating reusable modules, and managing infrastructure at scale.
agyos_skill.instructions: Specialized workflow for infrastructure as code using Terraform including resource provisioning, module creation, state management, and multi-environment deployments. Use this workflow when: - Provisioning cloud infrastructure - Creating Terraform modules - Managing multi-environment infra - Implementing IaC best practices - Setting up Terraform workflows - `terraform-skill` - Terraform basics - `terraform-specialist` - Advanced Terraform 1. Initialize Terraform 2. Configure backend 3. Set up providers 4. Configure variables 5. Create outputs ``` Use @terraform-skill to set up Terraform project ``` - `terraform-module-library` - Terraform modules - `cloud-architect` - Cloud architecture 1. Design infrastructure 2. Create resource definitions 3. Configure networking 4. Set up compute 5. Add storage ```
